title: KCF Review Envelope v1
description: An OPEN, portable record of a human review decision over specific constructs, bound to the exact source and model revisions it was made against. KCF-OSS validates this envelope STRUCTURALLY only - it deliberately does NOT authenticate the reviewer, verify authority, or check the signature's cryptographic validity. `signature`/`signatureAlgorithm` are opaque to KCF-OSS; an external platform is responsible for identity, authority, and key trust. A structurally-valid envelope is therefore provenance metadata, NOT proof of governed approval - downstream systems must not treat an unsigned or unverified envelope as cryptographically governed.

reviewer.description: A reviewer identifier (name, subject, or opaque handle). Self-asserted at the OSS layer.

reviewerRole.description: The role the reviewer is claiming to act in (e.g. 'Order Operations Owner'). Self-asserted.

authority.description: The authority under which the decision is claimed (e.g. an authority/capability id). KCF-OSS records it; it does not verify the reviewer actually holds it.

constructIds.description: The stable KCF semantic identities (qualifiedName or id) this decision applies to. Empty is allowed for a whole-model decision but discouraged.

sourceRevision.description: The revision (content hash or version) of the editable .kcf source this decision was made against. Binds the decision to exactly what was reviewed so a later source edit does not silently inherit the approval.

modelRevision.description: The revision (fingerprint/hash) of the compiled model IR this decision was made against.

recordedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the decision was recorded.

rationale.description: Optional free-text rationale for the decision.

signature.description: An OPAQUE signature over the envelope's governed fields, produced by an external platform. KCF-OSS does not compute or verify it. Null means unsigned (provenance only).

signatureAlgorithm.description: The algorithm/keyref that produced `signature` (e.g. 'hmac-sha256', 'ed25519'), for the external verifier. Opaque to KCF-OSS.
